title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:24:2:00028:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 24-2 (Maximum Expiration Date for Claims for Reimbursement by Mail)
① The Minister of the Ministry of Science and Technology and Communications shall, in accordance with Article 16 of the Act, issue a notice to reimbursement claims for mail payments that have not been made within the prescribed period, specifying that the claims must be made by the end of the previous year's October (if the expiration date falls in the first half of the year) or by the end of the current year's April (if the expiration date falls in the second half of the year). <Amended March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
② The notice required by Article 1 shall be delivered by mail.
